description: This file defines React component functions related to heading block plugins for a rich text editor, using the Lexical framework. Specifically, it creates an array of heading options (Heading 1, Heading 2, Heading 3) with associated icons and selection handling logic.

methods.name: GetHeadingsBlocks
methods.description: Creates an array of heading option objects each with a name, icon, keywords, and onSelect function for updating the editor with the selected heading.
